policy: Release is the earliest publicly accessible version of the same paper, including preprints and full author reports. For arXiv use v1, never the latest revision. Earlier verified public versions take precedence over arXiv. Do not substitute date-written, private submission, acceptance, DOI-embedded or issue-year dates. Dates are earliest verified, not proof that no inaccessible earlier copy existed.
scope: Papers behind the 50 claims in the blog post.
